title: Machine Learning Projects
summary: A personal collection of Jupyter Notebook machine learning exercises covering digit recognition, credit card fraud detection, and large purchase order prediction. In the order-prediction notebook, RDT's HyperTransformer is imported and run directly to auto-detect and configure column-wise data transformations for model input.
needs: Only one notebook in this multi-project repo actually calls RDT; the rest are unrelated ML exercises.
